summary: SAIHEAT Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 5, 2026, disclosing a change in control. Peng Zhang transferred one ordinary share of Energy Science Artist Holding Limited, representing 100% of its issued capital, to Longwin Global Limited for $1,000,000. This transaction resulted in Longwin Global becoming the sole controlling shareholder of SAIHEAT. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16. It does not detail a board recommendation or advisors. The share transfer effectively acquires the corporate entity that holds control of SAIHEAT. Watch for further regulatory filings and any strategic changes under the new controlling shareholder.
